format: WGP4 little-endian fixed records; neighbour IDs reconstructed from the existing model, checked by FNV1a-ID fingerprint

method.neighbours: Raw game-vector dot products; top256 float32 BLAS candidates refined in float64, conservative error-bound fallback; self excluded, lexical ties.
method.geometry: Unit-normalized existing vectors for diagnostics only. No game model changes.
method.clustering: Deterministic two-way spherical partition, first/farthest seeds,8 iterations; not identified dictionary senses.
method.silhouette: Exact mean cosine-distance silhouette from cluster sums; singleton silhouette0.
method.stability: Adjusted Rand index against k200 on shared neighbours; labels can swap.
method.broad_counts: Float32 similarity threshold sensitivity; possible boundary rounding.
